title_jp: {紅葉|こうよう}の{見頃|みごろ}
context: News: autumn colours are moving down from the mountains to the cities. Weathernews' 29 October forecast put Mt Takao in Tokyo at its best from around 13 November and Kyoto's Arashiyama from around 23 November. A warm autumn made the season a little later than usual.

phrases.jp: {紅葉|こうよう}が{見頃|みごろ}ですね。
phrases.en: The autumn leaves are at their best, aren't they?
phrases.note: {見頃|みごろ} = the best time to see something. Also used for cherry blossoms.

phrases.jp: {今年|ことし}は{紅葉|こうよう}が{遅|おそ}いそうです。
phrases.en: I hear the leaves are late this year.
phrases.note: Plain form + そうです = "I heard that…". Perfect for passing on news.

phrases.jp: おすすめの{紅葉|こうよう}スポットはありますか。
phrases.en: Do you know a good spot for autumn leaves?

phrases.jp: {朝早|あさはや}く{行|い}ったほうがいいですか。
phrases.en: Is it better to go early in the morning?

phrases.jp: めっちゃきれい！{写真|しゃしん}{撮|と}ろう！

dialogue_setting: At breakfast, the TV is showing the autumn leaves report.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.jp: {見|み}て、{高尾山|たかおさん}の{紅葉|こうよう}が{今|いま}{見頃|みごろ}だって。
dialogue.en: Look, they say the leaves on Mt Takao are at their best now.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.jp: {京都|きょうと}はどうですか。

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.jp: {嵐山|あらしやま}は{来週|らいしゅう}ぐらいからだって。{今年|ことし}はちょっと{遅|おそ}いみたい。
dialogue.en: Arashiyama starts around next week. It seems a bit late this year.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.jp: {週末|しゅうまつ}に{行|い}きたいです！{混|こ}みますか。
dialogue.en: I'd like to go at the weekend! Does it get crowded?

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.jp: すごく{混|こ}むよ。{朝早|あさはや}く{行|い}ったほうがいいね。
dialogue.en: Very crowded. Better to go early in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.jp: じゃあ、{始発|しはつ}で{行|い}きます！
dialogue.en: Then I'll take the first train!

kanji.where: On station posters, tourist boards and the TV weather: 紅葉情報 (leaf reports). Same kanji, two readings: こうよう for the autumn colours, もみじ for maple trees.
kanji.related: Related: {見頃|みごろ} best time to see, {色|いろ}づき{始|はじ}め just starting to change colour.

tip.title: Leaf hunting
tip.body: Going to see autumn leaves is called {紅葉狩|もみじが}り, literally "leaf hunting". Famous spots are packed on weekends, so locals go early in the morning or to smaller temples nearby. Many temples also hold evening illuminations (ライトアップ), which are worth the ticket.

challenge.prompt: Pass on the news to someone: "I heard the autumn leaves in Kyoto will be at their best next week."
challenge.hint: best time = {見頃|みごろ}, I heard = plain form + そうです
challenge.model_answer: {来週|らいしゅう}、{京都|きょうと}の{紅葉|こうよう}が{見頃|みごろ}になるそうです。
